dataSource: City of Baltimore DHCD Open Baltimore Datasets (ArcGIS FeatureServer), queried live
notes: Pulled live from the city's ArcGIS open data service on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.
Fields are auto-detected from the live schema rather than hardcoded, so this stays working if the city renames or reorders columns.
Matched by house number plus the first word of the street name; results may occasionally include unrelated records that happen to share both.
summary: Baltimore is covered by a live query against the city's public building permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
